steps: Remove only the installed main unit, resource drop-in and CyberBoss journald namespace configuration.
Restore the preserved current pointer; for this prestate, remove the current symlink.
Remove only the CB-100 release and newly created empty CyberBoss paths after verifying ownership and emptiness.
Remove the dedicated cyberboss user/group only after confirming no process or file outside the allowlist references them.
Run daemon-reload and recheck listeners, routes and unrelated services.
